Handmade lanterns for cozy evenings

We craft warm, low-energy lanterns from recycled glass and oak. Every piece is assembled by hand in our small workshop by the harbour.

Why customers choose us

  • Free shipping on orders over 50 euros
  • Two-year warranty on every lantern
  • Replacement glass available for ten years
  • Friendly support seven days a week

Our story →

How we work

Our designers sketch each new model on paper before a single sheet of glass is cut. We test prototypes in real homes for a whole winter and only keep the ones people refuse to give back.

The oak comes from certified forests less than two hundred kilometres away. Offcuts become coasters, and sawdust is donated to a local farm.

When a lantern finally leaves the workshop, it is wrapped in paper made from our own packaging waste.
